interpretation.plain_speak: The richer margin summaries help only a little. The strongest single feature, minimum absolute margin, still explains the needed correction only weakly. Wingless's calibration state is not collapsing cleanly to one obvious scalar.
interpretation.north_star_question: A useful native failure-risk estimate likely needs a compact combination of state features or explicit history/topology, not one threshold or one margin statistic.
interpretation.next_stage: fit a small preregistered multi-feature calibration model on the sealed states and evaluate it on disjoint new perturbation profiles and phases
